tPlan({
        localUserId,
        operationId,
        resetAt,
      });

      publishBudgetNoPlanState({ cacheKey, operationId });
      await refreshFinanceSection();
      closeFinanceModal();
      showFinanceNotice(
        "Budget reset. Your expense and wallet history were preserved.",
        "success"
      );
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      setBudgets(previousBudgets);
      showFinanceNotice("CLARA could not reset this budget. Nothing was changed.");
      return null;
    } finally {
      resetBudgetInFlightRef.current = false;
      setFinanceActionLoading(false);
    }
  }, [
    budgets,
    cacheKey,
    closeFinanceModal,
    financeActionLoading,
    refreshFinanceSection,
    setBudgets,
    showFinanceNotice,
    user?.email,
    user?.id,
  ]);''',
    )


def patch_finance_modal_copy():
    path = "src/components/fresh/main-dashboard/shell/DashboardFinanceModalRenderer.jsx"
    replace_required(path, 'title="Reset budget tracking"', 'title="Reset budget"')
    replace_required(
        path,
        'description="Start the active budget tracking window from right now."',
        'description="End the active budget plan and return to No Plan."',
    )
    replace_required(path, 'submitLabel="Reset tracking"', 'submitLabel="Reset budget"')
    replace_required(
        path,
        'This keeps your budget setup, but it resets the tracking start date to now.',
        'Your expense and wallet history will stay, but the active budget plan and its categories will end.',
    )
